title: Descent of ordinary strict open scalar comparison
statement: Fix the actual open operations o for j:U→X, coherent derived reduction calculi SX and SU, ordinary reductions AX and AU, and a natural isomorphism ordinary:extension⋙AX≅AU⋙systemExtension, in the interfaces of [def-sf-open-semilinear-tensor-model-data]. Assume extension preserves K-flat good complexes and their flat terms. Then there exists a natural derived isomorphism r:shriek⋙SX.reduction≅SU.reduction⋙J satisfying RepresentativeSquare with ordinary and the given K-flat witness. The computation witnesses in that square have the strict scalar-unit augmentation normalization. This is descent in the whole strict-system derived category.

source.place: Tag 0GL1, deriving the open tensor comparison through flat-term K-flat models; localization universal property and augmented computation.

proof.text: Choose the natural augmented computation isomorphisms for AU and AX on good models. K-flat and flat-term preservation define the extension functor between their full subcategories.

Apply ordinary degreewise to complexes. Whisker the two computation isomorphisms and the exact-extension localization comparisons to obtain an isomorphism after precomposition with the localization of good complexes.

That functor is a localization at quasi-isomorphisms [lem-pur-integral-operations-well-defined]. Lift the natural isomorphism by the localization universal property. Its component formula and inverse-hom cancellation give exactly RepresentativeSquare, with the augmented computations already chosen.

theorem openSemilinearReductionDescent
    (SX : CoefficientDerivedSystemCalculus l E X)
    (SU : CoefficientDerivedSystemCalculus l E U)
    (cX : CoefficientDerivedSystemCoherence l E X SX)
    (cU : CoefficientDerivedSystemCoherence l E U SU)
    (o : Operations l E j) (AX : OrdinaryReduction l E X) (AU : OrdinaryReduction l E U)
    (ordinary : IntegralOpenReduction.extension l E j o ⋙ AX.functor ≅
      AU.functor ⋙ IntegralOpenReduction.systemExtension l E j o)
    (hk : KFlatPreservation l E j o)
    (hf : ∀ (Q : CochainComplex (scalarReductionSource l E U) ℤ),
      CochainComplex.IsKFlatIndependentCoefficients
        (R := completedIntegralCommRingSheafUnrestricted l E U) Q →
      flatTerms.{t + 1, t, max u (t + 1)} (ProEt.topology U)
        (completedIntegralCommRingSheafUnrestricted l E U) Q →
      flatTerms.{t + 1, t, max u (t + 1)} (ProEt.topology X)
        (completedIntegralCommRingSheafUnrestricted l E X) ((extensionComplex l E j o).obj Q)) :
    ∃ r : IntegralOpenReduction.shriek l E j o ⋙ SX.reduction ≅
      SU.reduction ⋙ IntegralOpenReduction.J l E j o,
      RepresentativeSquare l E j o SX SU AX AU r ordinary hk
